utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sam, I appreciate you offering the tools. Let's make a list of what you have so we can coordinate with the other donations.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing, Eli. I've got a solid set of wrenches, a couple of screwdriver kits, and a power drill we can throw in the mix.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that'll cover a lot of the basic fixes. Let's set a time Saturday morning to sort everything — I'll bring my clipboard with the schedule.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: The drive starts at the community center at 9. I'll be there early, hoping someone can help with my stubborn toaster.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful Uli! The community center has plenty of space and outlets, so your toaster will be in good hands on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa. That's a relief. I've been making toast with a fork, so this is a big deal for me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So we're finally getting that repair drive organized — what exactly are we fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right! My toaster — is that still on the list? I keep forgetting if I'm supposed to bring it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Your toaster? That's a small appliance, not really what I had in mind — are we starting with the community center's broken printer or something more urgent?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, just wanted to let you know the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sunday at the community center? Wait, I thought it was Saturday at the front porch. Thanks for the heads up, Gus.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, things got shifted last minute. I already packed up my tool kit for the new spot.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hey Quinn, I've been hearing a lot about that repair drive. What exactly are we fixing up?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center now, not Saturday at the front porch like before.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, Sunday at the community center—good to know. I was worried I'd miss it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh yes, I'm planning to be there! Just need to figure out the timing with the kids' activities.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's wonderful, Faye! No worries on timing — we'll be there all day, so come whenever works for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, that's a relief. I'll try to swing by after dropping the kids off at their morning classes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Pia! You're going to the repair drive this Saturday at 10, right? We need all hands on deck!

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, I'll be there, but are we sure we have all the tools we need? I don't want to start and realize we're missing something.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, no worries about that! I've already rounded up a good stash — wrenches, screwdrivers, and even a spare drill from Mr. Chen.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, right, the repair drive—it got moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sunday? That's not what I've been telling everyone—I've been saying Saturday! Are you sure it got moved?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, I think so—I saw a note about it somewhere. But I could be mixing things up, you know how busy I get.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I still can't figure out where we're supposed to meet for the repair drive. Did anyone mention a specific spot?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh, there was a change! It's not at the front porch on Saturday anymore—it's moved to Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sunday at the community center, got it—thanks for letting me know!

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Do you have the exact address for the repair drive, Hana? I want to be sure I'm not heading to the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I know it's at the community center, but I don't have the exact address. Maybe we should double-check with Vik?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Vik usually has the details down to the last door number. I'll text him now to get that exact address.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Mara, did you hear the repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center? Just wanted to make sure you knew about the change.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, Rosa let me know! I was a bit surprised by the change, but it still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, I'm glad it works for you! I was worried not everyone got the memo.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday morning works. I'll be there at 10 with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Hold on — just to be clear, we're really doing this repair drive thing on Saturday at 10? I want to make sure I've got the right info.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yeah, Saturday at 10. Driveway repairs first.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Dane! Don't forget the repair drive this Saturday at the community center. I've been telling everyone to bring their broken items!

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, I remember! I've got my tools ready, and I'll actually be on time this Saturday—10 AM sharp, right?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That's right, Dane! 10 AM sharp at the community center. I've been telling everyone to bring their broken stuff for fixing!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well hey there Oren, did you catch the news? That repair drive got moved to Sunday at the community center now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sunday, you say? Oh thank goodness, I thought I'd already missed it. My toaster's still in the trunk of my car.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, you're right on time! Want me to grab my multimeter to check that toaster before Sunday?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Eli, you heard the repair drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center now, right?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sunday? That's a change from the original plan. I hope everyone got the memo.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I was just out running errands and heard it from a few folks — seems like word is getting around slowly.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Right, the repair drive! I remember Vik mentioned it's this Saturday at the community center. Are you planning to bring something in for fixing?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I've got an old toaster that's been acting up — figured I'd bring it by and see if anyone can work their magic on it!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: A toaster, huh? I'm sure someone there will know how to handle it. Did you check if it's a simple wiring issue or something deeper?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think they're setting up near the old garage on Elm Street.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Elm Street? I thought it was moved to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Oh, I didn't hear about that change… I was told the garage just yesterday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Got it, Sunday at the community center sounds perfect. I'll let Noah know too, since I was just talking to him about rounding people up.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thanks Jules! I'll make sure to have the sign-up sheet ready at the center. And if Noah needs any flyers, I can drop some off.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Awesome, I'll tell Noah about the change and see if he wants any flyers. Thanks for keeping everything organized, Rosa!

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: So where are we meeting for the repair drive, then?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Oh, it got moved to Sunday — we'll be at the community center instead of the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Okay, Sunday at the community center — what time should I be there?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Look, I'm still fretting about the socket wrench situation. Can we do a quick tool check before anyone commits to bringing appliances?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: You're right, a tool check sounds smart. But first, can you confirm where exactly we're meeting for the repair drive? I need the precise spot.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good point — we're meeting in the community garage on Elm Street, right behind the old bakery. I'll grab my tool list and meet you there in ten minutes.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh, Bo! It's this Saturday — we're fixing up broken stuff from sewing machines to lawn mowers, all to keep things out of the landfill. You should come by!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Count me in, Cleo! I'll bring my tool kit and be there early to help set up.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That's wonderful, Sam! Having you early to set up will be a huge help. I'll make sure to have a strong coffee ready for you.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday morning works for me, as long as it doesn't clash with the kids' soccer games. I'll see if I can drop by with some spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I almost forgot to mention—they moved it to Sunday afternoon at the community center, not Saturday. Hope that still works with your schedule!

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday afternoon should be fine—no soccer games then. I'll be there with those spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Uh, I think it's on Sunday at the community center now? Or was that something else?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, I thought it was Saturday. Did it change?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think it did change — Sunday at the community center, I'm pretty sure.
